paper: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
geometry: Evoformer pair state + structure module
symmetry: 结构模块全局SE(3)不变/等变
key_idea: MSA与pair表示交替更新，结构模块迭代生成坐标
strengths: pair到attention的信息流有充分实证
limitations: 完整系统重、训练与数据成本高

paper: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
geometry: pair representation、triangle update/attention
key_idea: 把残基对作为可持续演化的一等状态
strengths: 适合承载距离、方向、链关系和置信度
limitations: dense L²内存

paper: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
geometry: 局部frame中的query/key/value points
symmetry: 全局SE(3)不变attention；坐标更新等变
key_idea: 把学习到的局部点变到全局并用点间距离调制注意力
strengths: 几何表达强且有严格不变性说明
limitations: 点对距离和dense attention成本高

paper: Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3
geometry: Pairformer持续更新pair representation
symmetry: 生成端结合扩散与几何约束
key_idea: 以Pairformer替换Evoformer作为主要trunk
strengths: 支持多类生物分子相互作用
limitations: 系统边界远超单一界面分类器
recommendation: 借鉴pair初始化与head bias接口

paper: Accurate prediction of protein structures and interactions using a three-track neural network
geometry: 1D/2D/3D三轨交互；SE(3)-Transformer
key_idea: 序列、距离图和坐标表示端到端交换信息
strengths: 说明跨表示迭代的重要性
limitations: 不是轻量pair编码插件

paper: OpenFold: retraining AlphaFold2 yields new insights into its learning mechanisms and capacity for generalization
geometry: 可复现AlphaFold2训练与推理
key_idea: 开放训练栈用于复现和机制研究
strengths: 工程参考与可审计实现
limitations: 仍是大型折叠系统

paper: Robust deep learning-based protein sequence design using ProteinMPNN
geometry: backbone局部几何与message passing
symmetry: 使用相对距离/方向避免全局姿态依赖
key_idea: 在给定骨架上自回归设计序列
strengths: 结构条件设计强基线、工程成熟
limitations: 目标是序列设计而非界面分类

paper: Learning inverse folding from millions of predicted structures
geometry: invariant geometric preprocessing + GVP Transformer
symmetry: 结构输入全局姿态不变
key_idea: 用数百万预测结构扩展逆折叠训练
strengths: 结构条件语言建模强基线
limitations: 历史仓库归档；非pair-trunk

paper: Learning from Protein Structure with Geometric Vector Perceptrons
geometry: 标量-向量双通道
key_idea: 用轻量向量通道保留方向信息
strengths: 比全irreps简单，适合side encoder
limitations: 需谨慎管理向量特征和mask

paper: PiFold: Toward effective and efficient protein inverse folding
geometry: 多种残基/边几何特征 + PiGNN
key_idea: 一次性非自回归逆折叠
strengths: 效率高、特征消融充分
limitations: 恢复率不直接等价于界面预测能力

paper: Structure-informed Language Models Are Protein Designers
geometry: 轻量structural adapter注入pLM
key_idea: 无需从零训练蛋白语言模型即可获得结构条件能力
strengths: 参数高效、可复用预训练序列知识
limitations: adapter不替代连续pair几何

paper: AntiFold: improved antibody structure-based design using inverse folding
geometry: ESM-IF1微调；可含抗原上下文
key_idea: 面向抗体和CDR的结构条件序列设计
strengths: 抗体专项、开放权重
limitations: 设计分数不等价于真实结合提升

paper: Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model
geometry: pLM表示 + folding trunk/structure module
symmetry: 结构模块使用几何不变/等变机制
key_idea: 以大规模语言模型替代显式MSA检索主路径
strengths: 推理快、单序列结构基线
limitations: 复合物与界面不是主要目标

paper: Uni-Mol: A Universal 3D Molecular Representation Learning Framework
geometry: 原子距离bias与坐标恢复预训练
symmetry: 以距离为主，平移/旋转不变
key_idea: 在大规模分子构象与蛋白口袋上预训练3D表示
strengths: 3D预训练任务和pair bias参考价值高
limitations: 分子/口袋尺度与蛋白残基frame不同

paper: Protein Representation Learning by Geometric Structure Pretraining
geometry: 多关系残基图、边消息传递
key_idea: 几何图预训练迁移到蛋白功能任务
strengths: 蛋白结构预训练强基线
limitations: 不显式表达完整相对刚体姿态

paper: Fast and accurate protein structure search with Foldseek
geometry: 局部三维相互作用离散为3Di字母
symmetry: 局部相对几何不依赖全局姿态
key_idea: 把结构近邻环境编码为可序列检索的字母表
strengths: 高效、为SaProt等提供token
limitations: 量化丢失连续细节

paper: SaProt: Protein Language Modeling with Structure-aware Vocabulary
geometry: 氨基酸token与Foldseek 3Di联合词表
key_idea: 在约4000万序列-结构样本上预训练结构感知pLM
strengths: 接口简单、下游覆盖广
limitations: 离散token无法替代连续跨链姿态

paper: ProSST: Protein Language Modeling with Quantized Structure and Disentangled Attention
geometry: 量化局部结构token + disentangled attention
key_idea: 显式建模序列token与结构token关系
strengths: 清晰的双模态attention设计
limitations: 结构量化瓶颈；不能恢复精确跨链几何

paper: DPLM-2: A Multimodal Diffusion Protein Language Model
geometry: lookup-free量化的结构token
key_idea: 联合建模序列和结构的离散扩散
strengths: 统一生成、折叠和逆折叠
limitations: token化造成几何细节损失
recommendation: 不作为第一版界面分类器

paper: Elucidating the Design Space of Multimodal Protein Language Models
geometry: token与几何模块的系统消融
key_idea: 识别tokenization loss和错误结构token预测瓶颈
strengths: 为离散/连续融合提供负面证据
limitations: 结论基于其模型族和数据
recommendation: 支持连续pair几何必须保留

paper: Protein Structure Tokenization: Benchmarking and New Recipe
geometry: 结构tokenizer统一评测
key_idea: 分离重建、表示和下游能力评估
strengths: 提醒不能只看单一token重建指标
limitations: 不是界面模型

paper: SE(3)-Transformers: 3D Roto-Translation Equivariant Attention Networks
geometry: 球谐/irreps上的等变attention
key_idea: 在3D点云上实现连续旋转平移等变注意力
strengths: 理论严谨、表达力强
limitations: 高阶表示和kernel成本高
recommendation: 纯标量界面分类不作为第一版

paper: E(n) Equivariant Graph Neural Networks
geometry: 距离驱动标量消息与坐标更新
key_idea: 无需高阶表示实现高维等变GNN
strengths: 简单高效
limitations: E(3)反射等变意味着单靠距离难表达手性

paper: Tensor Field Networks: Rotation- and Translation-Equivariant Neural Networks for 3D Point Clouds
geometry: 球谐滤波器与张量特征
key_idea: 用表示论构造连续3D等变卷积
strengths: 后续SE(3)网络基础
limitations: 实现复杂、计算重

paper: Equiformer: Equivariant Graph Attention Transformer for 3D Atomistic Graphs
geometry: irreps + tensor products + graph attention
key_idea: 将Transformer算子系统替换为等变版本
strengths: 3D原子图性能强
limitations: 对标量界面分类可能过重

paper: EquiformerV2: Improved Equivariant Transformer for Scaling to Higher-Degree Representations
geometry: SO(2)卷积、S²激活、可分离归一化
key_idea: 提高高阶表示的可扩展性和稳定性
strengths: 大型3D原子任务强
limitations: 依赖专门等变算子
recommendation: 仅在高阶向量任务比较

paper: EquiformerV3: Scaling Efficient, Expressive, and General SE(3)-Equivariant Graph Attention Transformers
geometry: 平滑cutoff attention与SwiGLU-S²
key_idea: 同时提升实现效率、表达力与势能面光滑性
strengths: 最新高阶等变工程参考
limitations: 原子势任务；需独立验证迁移

paper: SE(3) Equivariant Graph Neural Networks with Complete Local Frames
geometry: 由叉积构造完备正交局部frame
key_idea: 将张量信息投影到局部完备基避免方向退化
strengths: 支持右手frame与手性表达的理论路线
limitations: 退化/缺失原子仍需mask和回退

paper: Equivariant message passing for the prediction of tensorial properties and molecular spectra
geometry: 标量与三维向量消息传递
key_idea: 以轻量标量/向量交互预测张量性质
strengths: 比全irreps简洁
limitations: 分子原子任务；跨链pair需另建

paper: E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for data-efficient and accurate interatomic potentials
geometry: irreps与等变message passing
key_idea: 用严格对称性提高原子势的数据效率
strengths: 对称归纳偏置的强实证
limitations: 能量/力任务与界面分类不同

paper: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
geometry: 1D token位置的二维子空间旋转
symmetry: 精确编码相对序列位移
key_idea: 通过query/key旋转把相对位移写入点积
strengths: 成熟、高效、kernel友好
limitations: 标准形式不是任意3D旋转不变

paper: Rotary Position Embedding for Vision Transformer
geometry: 2D视觉网格的轴向/混合RoPE
symmetry: 网格平移相对性；非3D旋转不变
key_idea: 将RoPE推广到视觉二维位置
strengths: 多维RoPE强基线
limitations: 规则网格假设不适合蛋白局部刚体

paper: Learning the RoPEs: Better 2D and 3D Position Encodings with STRING
geometry: 任意维坐标的可分离平移不变编码
symmetry: 精确共同平移不变；不自动保证3D旋转不变
key_idea: 统一低成本多维RoPE并证明平移不变性/通用性
strengths: 理论和高效kernel设计价值高
limitations: 蛋白还需局部frame或旋转处理

paper: LieRE: Lie Rotational Positional Encodings
geometry: 学习Lie代数生成元并指数映射到SO(d)
symmetry: 一般高维相对位置；性质取决于生成元
key_idea: 以稠密可学习旋转推广RoPE
strengths: 表达空间大于固定二维旋转块
limitations: 全局xyz输入仍不自动获得SE(3)不变性

paper: Group Representational Position Encoding
geometry: 群作用下的乘法旋转与加法logit bias统一框架
symmetry: 精确相对组合律；可扩展到2D/3D
key_idea: 统一RoPE、ALiBi及可学习群表示
strengths: 同时解释additive和multiplicative设计
limitations: 通用理论不等于蛋白SE(3)适配已验证

paper: GeoPE: A Unified Geometric Positional Embedding for Structured Tensors
geometry: 四元数/Lie代数几何均值耦合空间轴
symmetry: 面向结构化张量；非蛋白SE(3)专用
key_idea: 避免各空间轴完全独立造成的拓扑错配
strengths: 强调耦合几何而非分轴处理
limitations: 新近预印本；蛋白场景未验证

paper: Cameras as Relative Positional Encoding
geometry: 相对相机内外参与完整frustum编码
symmetry: 相对相机坐标减少全局frame依赖
key_idea: 把camera conditioning放入attention级相对编码
strengths: 证明完整相对pose比token附加更有效
limitations: 相机frustum不是蛋白残基frame

paper: RayRoPE: Projective Ray Positional Encoding for Multi-view Attention
geometry: query-frame投影坐标与多频旋转
key_idea: 在query frame中编码沿相机光线预测点
strengths: 直接证明query-frame相对坐标路线可行
limitations: 光线与深度不确定性不同于蛋白frame
recommendation: 最接近相对frame rotary的视觉参考

paper: URoPE: Universal Relative Position Embedding across Geometric Spaces
geometry: 沿射线深度anchor投影到query图像平面
symmetry: 参数无关、内参感知、全局SE(3)不变
key_idea: 把跨视图/2D-3D几何转为标准2D RoPE可消费坐标
strengths: 兼容已有RoPE优化kernel
limitations: 蛋白没有固定相机投影模型

paper: ComRoPE: Scalable and Robust Rotary Position Embedding Parameterized by Trainable Commuting Angle Matrices
geometry: 可训练且两两可交换的角矩阵
key_idea: 在可扩展约束下学习多维旋转子空间
strengths: 兼顾表达力、稳定与效率
limitations: 不直接解决输入坐标的物理旋转不变性

paper: Flash Invariant Point Attention
geometry: IPA因式分解并利用FlashAttention
key_idea: 降低长序列IPA显存与时间瓶颈
strengths: 可扩展到数千残基生成
limitations: 需要专门kernel和硬件验证
complexity: 论文报告内存/时间近线性扩展

paper: PeSTo: parameter-free geometric deep learning for accurate prediction of protein binding interfaces
geometry: 原子点云的标量/向量几何Transformer
key_idea: 仅用元素和坐标预测多类结合界面
strengths: 界面预测强且计算较轻
limitations: 单体表面倾向不等于特定抗体条件表位

paper: Independent SE(3)-Equivariant Models for End-to-End Rigid Protein Docking
geometry: 独立等变编码、关键点匹配与Kabsch
symmetry: 对两单体初始姿态独立等变
key_idea: 直接预测刚性对接pose而非重采样大量候选
strengths: blind pose设置的明确几何基线
limitations: 刚性假设；界面柔性受限

paper: DiffDock-PP: Rigid Protein-Protein Docking with Diffusion Models
geometry: SE(3)上的扩散式刚体pose生成
key_idea: 对蛋白相对旋转和平移采样并排序
strengths: 表达多模态对接pose
limitations: 采样成本；结果依赖候选与评分

paper: Learning Harmonic Molecular Representations on Riemannian Manifold
geometry: 分子表面Laplace-Beltrami特征与谐波消息传递
symmetry: 基于内在表面谱的表示
key_idea: 在二维黎曼流形上做多分辨率几何编码
strengths: 口袋分类和刚性对接显示通用性
limitations: 表面预处理重、存储成本高
complexity: 谱预处理 + surface message passing

paper: Accurate protein-protein interactions modeling through physics-informed geometric invariant learning
geometry: SE(3)-invariant encoder + trigonometry/物理互补性
key_idea: 在弱共进化场景用表面向量与几何互补增强跨链contact
strengths: 覆盖界面、对接和reranking
limitations: 需审计bound/predicted结构和数据split

paper: EpiFormer: Learning Antigen-Antibody Interactions for Epitope Prediction via Geometric Deep Learning
geometry: GNN层内交错双向cross-attention
symmetry: 取决于选用GNN backbone；支持等变backbone
key_idea: 早期融合抗体与抗原，而非末端拼接
strengths: 直接针对抗体条件表位与类别不平衡
limitations: 预印本；split和泄漏需独立复现
recommendation: 真实抗原-抗体首要对照

paper: Simulating 500 million years of evolution with a language model
geometry: 序列、结构和功能多轨token生成
key_idea: 统一多模态蛋白生成与条件推断
strengths: 大规模多模态先验
limitations: 规模大、结构token不能替代连续pair几何
recommendation: 可选上游embedding，不作为第一版

paper: FrameDiff: Diffusion Generative Models on SE(3) for Protein Backbone Generation
geometry: 残基刚体frame上的SE(3)扩散
key_idea: 直接在每残基frame流形上生成backbone
strengths: 严格处理平移与旋转扩散
limitations: 生成任务；不直接给界面分类表示

paper: De novo design of protein structure and function with RFdiffusion
geometry: RoseTTAFold frame/坐标表示上的去噪生成
symmetry: 结构网络保持几何等变性
key_idea: 将结构预测网络改造为蛋白backbone扩散生成器
strengths: 蛋白设计实证强、含复合物/结合体设计
limitations: 目标和训练成本远超表位分类
recommendation: 说明frame+pair路线可扩展；非第一版组件

paper: GeoMFormer: A General Architecture for Geometric Molecular Representation Learning
geometry: 不变标量流与等变向量流双路Transformer
key_idea: 标准attention模块通过跨流attention融合标量和向量
strengths: 系统化sequence/geometry双流融合设计
limitations: 分子任务为主；接入ESM需要缩小向量分支
recommendation: 作为GVP/等变side-stream的高成本对照，不直接首选

paper: Fast, accurate antibody structure prediction from deep learning on massive set of natural antibodies
geometry: 固定模板坐标上的IPA结构感知self-attention
key_idea: 把PLM node/attention edge表示与固定坐标IPA融合
strengths: 直接证明IPA可用作结构感知self-attention而非只做坐标更新
limitations: 目标是抗体结构预测；模板腐化训练与当前界面分类不同
recommendation: 作为IPA-lite最强直接动机，列入第二阶段消融

paper: PepNN: a deep attention model for the identification of peptide binding sites
geometry: 每残基局部坐标图特征与ProtBert表示拼接
key_idea: 结构图节点特征直接拼接预训练sequence embedding
strengths: 与ESM + local-frame adapter接口接近
limitations: 肽结合位点不是抗体条件表位；简单拼接可能被高维PLM淹没
recommendation: 加入concat/projection作为融合基线，但以zero-init gated residual为主

paper: Inertial-frame 3D rotary positional encoding
geometry: 惯性主轴规范化 + 3D RoPE + 距离近似
symmetry: 依赖惯性frame规范化；退化特征值处可能不稳定
key_idea: 先对点云确定规范坐标系再使用xyz RoPE
strengths: 保留标准token-wise RoPE路径
limitations: PCA/惯性轴符号与近简并不稳定；蛋白局部frame更可靠
recommendation: 作为负对照/敏感性实验，不作为主方法

paper: Transformers trained on proteins can learn to attend to Euclidean distance
geometry: 线性坐标嵌入使QK可学习三维Gaussian距离筛选
symmetry: 若直接输入xyz不保证解析SE(3)不变
key_idea: 证明标准Transformer可学习Euclidean distance attention
strengths: 说明不一定需要复杂等变算子
limitations: 需要数据增强学习坐标系鲁棒性；不提供局部方向/手性保证
recommendation: raw-coordinate augmentation对照，不能取代解析不变基线

paper: Geometric Hyena Networks for Large-scale Equivariant Learning
geometry: SE(3)等变长卷积
key_idea: 用隐式长卷积提供次二次全局几何上下文
strengths: 适合超长全原子序列，论文报告30k token效率优势
limitations: 与当前残基self-attention接口差异大；不是位置编码插件
recommendation: 长抗原阶段的独立架构基线，第一轮不直接嫁接

paper: PPDiff: Diffusing in Hybrid Sequence-Structure Space for Protein-Protein Complex Design
geometry: 全局self-attention与局部kNN等变图卷积交错
key_idea: 显式交错sequence全局通路和structure局部通路
strengths: 与当前问题的双通路因素分解高度一致
limitations: 生成任务且有causal/diffusion组件；不能直接比较指标
recommendation: 实现轻量interleaved GVP/EGNN side-layer作为第二阶段强基线

paper: Cross-Modality Attention with Mixture-of-Experts for Antibody Binding Site Prediction
geometry: PLM、结构、理化与GCN模态的adaptive fusion/MoE
key_idea: 按样本动态加权多种sequence/structure模态
strengths: 直接讨论抗体结合位点的模态竞争
limitations: 匿名代码、尚非正式发表；复杂MoE容易在小数据过拟合
recommendation: 只借鉴modality gate和dropout诊断，不直接复制完整MoE

paper: Protein Structure Tokenization via Geometric Byte Pair Encoding
geometry: SE(3)端frame约束的多尺度几何片段token
key_idea: 像BPE一样把局部几何合并为可解释多尺度motif
strengths: 支持局部到motif多尺度表示
limitations: 预处理和词表学习较重；尚非residue pair bias
recommendation: 长程motif通路候选，不进入第一轮六档消融

paper: Antigen-specific Antibody Multi-modal Foundation Model for Functional Antibody Design
geometry: 跨模态adapter融合抗体序列结构与抗原界面/表位
key_idea: 在共享latent中显式抗原条件化并用偏好优化
strengths: 直接针对antigen-specific表征，附官方代码
limitations: 2026-07新预印本；任务和数据边界需独立审计
complexity: 基础模型 + adapter + preference optimization
recommendation: cross-attention阶段的重要对照，不改变当前intra-chain首阶段

paper: AgForce Enables Antigen-conditioned Generative Antibody Design
geometry: GNN encoder + gated bottleneck + hyperbolic cross-attention
key_idea: 用framework dropout和cycle consistency防止模型忽略抗原
strengths: 把partner blindness变成可测试故障模式
limitations: 生成任务；不能直接作为self-attention位置编码

paper: ConTact: Contact-First Antibody CDR Design via Explicit Interface Reasoning
geometry: 距离偏置cross-attention + contact gate
symmetry: 复合物frame下相对距离不变
key_idea: 先预测接触再用contact加权抗原特征
strengths: 显式分解contact reasoning和sequence action
limitations: 需要已对齐复合物/候选pose；非单体self-attention
recommendation: 未来cross-attention decoder参考，不用于未对齐单体直接坐标差

paper: Wavelet-Induced Rotary Encodings: RoPE Meets Graphs
geometry: 图wavelet/谱位置映射到RoPE式QK旋转
symmetry: 图同构结构；不直接编码三维SE(3)
key_idea: 把RoPE相对相位从线性序列推广到图结构
strengths: 可能同时表达序列邻接与空间图拓扑
limitations: 图谱基对扰动/简并敏感；不直接保留手性方向
recommendation: 研究参考；只有六档基线稳定后再做图谱rotary

paper: Deciphering Fingerprints of 3D Molecular Surfaces for Accurate Epitope Prediction
geometry: 表面patch、法向/曲率/化学特征、测地距离attention
symmetry: 以表面内在几何和局部特征为主
key_idea: binder-aware cross-attention与coarse-to-fine表位预测
strengths: 直接针对不连续抗原表面和未见抗体泛化
limitations: 预印本；表面生成管线重且必须训练/外部一致
recommendation: 先做antigen exposure gate，再评估surface token

paper: AsEP: Benchmarking Deep Learning Methods for Antibody-specific Epitope Prediction
geometry: 抗体/抗原图与PLM融合，二部图link prediction
key_idea: 按epitope group聚类评估未见表位泛化
strengths: 公开数据代码、直接任务、适合新外部证据
limitations: 需与SAbDab2训练集做PDB/序列/epitope-group去污染

paper: A two-stage point cloud framework with hierarchical embedding and antigen-antibody interaction modeling for epitope prediction
geometry: 全原子点云、residue-aware聚合、cross-attention
symmetry: 点云局部几何；实现性质需代码审计
key_idea: 先原子级预训练再做抗体条件化残基表位预测
strengths: 直接比较AsEP group split并纳入预测结构
limitations: 比N/CA/C adapter重，公开实现和split复现需核验
complexity: atom point cloud encoder + cross-attention decoder
recommendation: 全原子高成本上界，不作为第一轮drop-in

paper: An equivariant pretrained transformer for unified 3D molecular representation learning
geometry: all-atom scalar/vector E(3)-equivariant Transformer
key_idea: 跨小分子、蛋白和复合物的block-aware 3D预训练
strengths: 大规模预训练、同时建模原子和residue block
limitations: 30M+参数且当前抗体表位任务未直接验证
recommendation: 紧凑local-frame方案饱和后的高成本上界

paper: PointTransformerX: Portable and Efficient 3D Point Cloud Processing without Sparse Algorithms
geometry: 每head Gram-Schmidt正交基上的3D rotary encoding
symmetry: 公开实验为点云坐标编码；非蛋白SE(3)解析不变
key_idea: 用原生PyTorch dense/window attention替代专用稀疏算子
strengths: 实现简洁且有速度/显存证据
limitations: 全局xyz旋转会改变相位；需局部frame或pair-conditioned改造
recommendation: 正交基参数化和工程参考，不直接嫁接全局xyz

paper: A paired sequence language model for protein-protein interaction modeling
geometry: intra-chain RoPE、inter-chain无位置编码的混合attention；下游融合单体距离图
symmetry: 跨链序列attention不强加伪空间位置；结构下游依赖不变单体距离
key_idea: 在超过330万protein pairs上预训练interaction-aware paired representation
strengths: 覆盖PPI、affinity、contact且有官方代码/权重路径
limitations: 当前仓库许可声明与论文文字需单独审计；训练截止与SAbDab2/AsEP重叠未知
recommendation: zero-gated frozen paired feature候选，审计后作为强序列pair基线

paper: Partner-Specific Protein-Protein Binding Site Prediction at Scale Using ProstT5 and Cross-Chain Attention
geometry: ProstT5结构语言表示 + cross-chain attention + contact supervision
symmetry: sequence-only推理；结构信息来自预训练token
key_idea: 系统量化冗余阈值对partner-specific binding-site指标的膨胀
strengths: 最多32503个非冗余pair并报告多阈值和外部测试
limitations: 通用PPI而非抗体专项；预印本且结构fold泛化需独立审计
recommendation: 大数据sequence-only partner-aware控制与冗余审计参考

paper: Contrastive learning for antibody-antigen sequence-to-specificity prediction
geometry: dual encoder + cross-attentive decoder；sequence-only
key_idea: 把cognate antibody-antigen识别做成双向contrastive retrieval
strengths: 直接测Ab到Ag与Ag到Ab的partner specificity
limitations: 80% identity cluster split弱于结构fold；R@1仍低，不能替代contact定位
recommendation: 新增reciprocal retrieval R@K/MRR与hard-negative训练参考

paper: IgGM2: An All-Atom Foundation Model for Adaptive Immune Receptor Design
geometry: AF3-like Pairformer + full-atom diffusion；可接收epitope/contact guidance
symmetry: 扩散结构模块处理全局刚体对称性
key_idea: 统一抗体/TCR结构预测与抗原条件设计
strengths: 覆盖immune-complex benchmark和全原子设计
limitations: 未审计到可用官方checkpoint；训练算力远超当前项目
complexity: 大型Pairformer + diffusion，论文训练使用多A100
recommendation: 长期pose/design上界，不作为当前轻量编码的同预算对照

paper: CHIMERA: A Unified Benchmark for Antibody-Antigen Co-Design
geometry: canonical complex co-design数据与评估器
key_idea: 统一评估抗体序列与结构在抗原条件下的协同设计
strengths: 公开benchmark、数据与evaluator，能把contact representation接到设计效用
limitations: 其数据组名不能自动解释为Foldseek/TM-score结构fold；需训练集去污染
recommendation: FrameContact最终canonical downstream task，而非只借split做分类

paper: Efficient generation of epitope-targeted antibodies with Germinal
geometry: 结构预测器与抗体语言模型联合优化指定epitope的CDR结构/序列
key_idea: 低n实验筛选验证指定epitope的de novo binder
strengths: 四类target均获得功能抗体并公开计算/实验协议
limitations: 端到端实验设计pipeline，不能从retrospective contact AUPRC推断其成功率
complexity: 结构预测与迭代生成/筛选
recommendation: 将prospective binding/specifity设为最终行业效用标准

paper: The Synthetic Epitope Atlas: High-Throughput Design and Validation of De Novo Antibody-Antigen Complexes
geometry: 设计复合物pseudo-structure + 双侧alanine scanning
symmetry: 结构生成阶段依预测器
key_idea: 把超过2600万on/off-target affinity measurements与结构假设连接
strengths: 提供大规模specificity、hard-negative和突变证据
limitations: VHH/合成epitope域偏移与pseudo-structure误差必须单独审计
complexity: 高通量实验与结构计算混合管线
recommendation: 未来外部specificity/突变校准数据源，不并入当前test选择

paper: Expanding the scope of protein language modeling to protein-protein interactions with MSA Pairformer
geometry: MSA与residue-pair state双向更新、triangle operations和query-biased attention；不直接输入三维坐标
symmetry: pair state来自序列/共进化关系，不涉及全局SE(3)坐标
key_idea: 仅以单链训练，仍学习可迁移到PPI interface contact和binding discrimination的pair representation
strengths: 111M参数、官方代码/权重/分析数据；正式发表并直接评估interface contact
limitations: 需要高质量MSA；interface结果不是抗体特异结构fold证据，且进化共变与当前frozen ESM输入预算不同
complexity: 111M MSA+pair trunk，triangle更新为二次/三角局部主要成本
recommendation: 作为MSA-enabled contact上界和pair-trunk设计参考；不能替代same-antigen wrong-partner检验

paper: LC-SEPLM: long-range contact-supervised adaptation for sequence-only protein representation learning
geometry: 以长程残基接触监督和pair-specific cross-attention query对ESM2做LoRA适配；下游仍可sequence-only
symmetry: 训练标签为距离派生接触，不依赖全局坐标方向
key_idea: 用50万AlphaFold Swiss-Prot结构把长程contact约束蒸馏进ESM表示
strengths: 八个protein-level任务均相对ESM2改善，远同源macro-F1报告+0.0647
limitations: 未直接评估partner-specific PPI/contact；AlphaFold训练语料与SAbDab2/AsEP重叠和发布日期污染必须审计，当前未找到可审计官方代码
recommendation: 未来只在training-only或去污染外部语料上做contact-adapted ESM基线，不改变当前冻结阵列

paper: ABConformer: Physics-inspired Sliding Attention for Antibody-Antigen Interface Prediction
geometry: Conformer加sequence-axis sliding attention；用可学习伪位置和Gaussian bandwidth约束跨链注意力
symmetry: 不输入真实三维坐标；所谓spatial proximity是学习的序列伪位置而非SE(3)物理距离
key_idea: 在抗原与重/轻链之间迭代滑动，显式调节precision-recall权衡
strengths: 报告五折、precision/recall/F1/MCC和attention敏感性分析，直接比较self/cross/sliding attention
limitations: 抗原系统树分层不等于严格endpoint/结构fold；4Å heavy-atom标签和当前定义不同；敏感性只用单fold单seed，代码尚未公开
complexity: 三分支Conformer + 六层迭代sliding attention
recommendation: 借鉴固定阈值precision-recall轨迹和局部带宽消融；不把其伪位置当作未对齐单体的物理坐标解法

paper: EpiCLIP: Learning Antibody-Antigen Interactions from Approximate Interfaces
geometry: 将近似antigen surface patches与六条CDR形成的paratope candidate分别编码
symmetry: 候选接口由结构模型/表面patch提供；检索分数本身为embedding相似度
key_idea: 把binder retrieval和epitope mapping统一成approximate-interface dense retrieval
strengths: 训练候选分布显式匹配部署时的噪声候选，支持binder与patch两级排序
limitations: workshop论文；近似patch生成和当前全残基contact supervision不同，公开代码路径在本次审计中不可访问
complexity: 双encoder后可缓存候选，检索近似O(M+N)
recommendation: 将partner specificity明确评为方向分离的R@K/MRR；但不能用其候选patch结果代替contact-map指标

paper: EpiFormer: Learning Antigen-Antibody Interactions for Epitope Prediction via Geometric Deep Learning
geometry: 在interleaved cross-attention与bipartite edge head外，尝试intra/inter-chain residue InfoNCE
symmetry: 主模型为E(3)-equivariant图编码；contrastive项作用在归一化residue embedding
key_idea: 正负residue pair的标准InfoNCE未必与稀疏node/edge分类目标一致
strengths: 公开报告负面消融：加入InfoNCE后F1从0.496降至0.467
limitations: 这是residue-label contrastive而非cognate-vs-wrong-partner listwise retrieval；不能直接判定后者无效
complexity: 批内residue对比增加负样本相似度计算
recommendation: 任何检索损失必须设contact AUPRC/F1非退化门槛，并与partner R@1/MRR共同选型

paper: DeepRank-Ab: a scoring function for antibody-antigen complexes based on geometric deep learning
geometry: 原子级图、Voronoi表面分解与抗体专项界面特征
symmetry: 对已生成复合物decoy做几何图评分，不解决未对齐单体的直接位置编码
key_idea: 以约230万decoys和1442个complex训练近天然构象排序器
strengths: 独立测试、CAPRI external targets和AlphaFold3/HADDOCK对比，直接强调rank而非只做分类
limitations: 输入是候选complex pose；TopK docking success不能与单体contact AUPRC直接比较
complexity: 对每个decoy构建原子级界面图并打分
recommendation: 未来latent-pose ensemble的pose-ranker强基线；当前无pose阶段不直接接入

paper: A germline shortcut in protein language model retrieval of adaptive immune receptors
geometry: 无坐标；比较CDR3、paratope和完整可变区的冻结PLM/序列比对检索
key_idea: 随机切分中的clonal leakage和framework/germline信息可伪装成antigen-specific检索能力
strengths: 四个B/T-cell receptor数据库、germline reversion和clone-aware对照；报告随机切分使top-1膨胀15至28个百分点
limitations: 研究零样本免疫受体相似性检索，不直接评估抗体-抗原contact或结构fold
complexity: 冻结embedding或序列比对加近邻检索
recommendation: 把clone/CDR-cluster leakage审计列为partner-specific benchmark硬门槛；完整序列PLM增益不能自动解释为specificity

paper: Structural Plausibility Without Binding Specificity: Limits of AI-Based Antibody-Antigen Structure Prediction Confidence Scores
geometry: AlphaFold3、Boltz-2和Chai-1复合物结构及内部confidence
key_idea: 高结构置信度并不等价于cognate binding specificity
strengths: 106个实验complex、11342个shuffled non-cognate pairs和约180万生成结构；显式测真实pair排序
limitations: nanobody为主、依赖co-folding采样；confidence审计不是residue contact模型对照
complexity: 多模型多seed复合物生成与排序
recommendation: 保留wrong-partner ranking与calibration为主指标；不能用ipTM/PAE替代specificity证据

paper: RaftPPI: Residue-interaction Approximation with Fourier Features for Scalable Protein Interaction Retrieval
geometry: residue embedding间Gaussian kernel，以SORF近似并用低秩attention聚合
key_idea: 将每个蛋白独立压缩成可索引向量，同时保留近似residue-level interaction并自适应加权hard negatives
strengths: sequence/degree-controlled benchmark、ANN retrieval和官方代码；报告单A100/CPU分钟级proteome retrieval
limitations: 通用PPI而非抗体专项；可分解检索分数不能直接给出校准contact map
complexity: 每蛋白一次PLM编码，之后ANN检索；避免逐pair联合推理
recommendation: 借鉴model-confidence hard-negative weighting、retrieval Recall@K与高吞吐candidate mining；contact定位仍由FrameContact pair head负责

paper: SAbDab2: The structural antibody database in the age of machine learning
geometry: X-ray/cryo-EM抗体及抗体-抗原mmCIF；官方切分基于sequence connected components
key_idea: 提供versioned antibody-only和antibody-antigen-aware splits；多链antigen cluster以斜杠分隔
strengths: 15641个ML-grade结构、官方README给出CDR/antigen identity阈值并承诺半年更新
limitations: 官方split是sequence-based而非结构fold；metadata cluster不是germline或clonotype标签
complexity: 离线全局序列比对与connected-component clustering
recommendation: 对抗原任务使用antigen-aware authority，并额外叠加Foldseek结构hard edges；多链agclusters必须按token而非整串审计
